scripts.ss14-repo:clone-no-checkout: rimraf temp && mkdir temp && cd temp && mkdir _ss14-repo && cd _ss14-repo && git init && git remote add origin https://github.com/space-wizards/space-station-14.git && git sparse-checkout init && git sparse-checkout set Resources/
scripts.ss14-repo:clone-checkout:stable: bun run ss14-repo:clone-no-checkout && cd temp && cd _ss14-repo && git fetch --depth=1 origin stable && git checkout stable
scripts.ss14-repo:clone-checkout:master: bun run ss14-repo:clone-no-checkout && cd temp && cd _ss14-repo && git fetch --depth=1 origin master && git checkout master
scripts.sync:clone: mkdir temp && cd temp && rimraf temp _sync && mkdir _sync && cd _sync && git init && git remote add origin https://github.com/murolem/ss14-wiki-automations.git && git fetch --depth=1 origin sync && git checkout sync
scripts.start: bun run type-check && bun run test && bun run ss14-repo:clone-checkout:master && bun run start:noclone
scripts.start:noclone:nowiki: bun run copy-source-data && bun run convert-source-data && bun run process-converted-data
scripts.start:noclone: bun run start:noclone:nowiki && bun run process-for-wiki-and-upload
scripts.start:nowiki: bun run ss14-repo:clone-checkout:master && bun run start:noclone:nowiki
